intuition: Queries ask whether any number occupies a frequency, so track how many distinct numbers have each frequency.

brute_force.approach: Store all values and count each value's occurrences for every query.

optimal.approach: Maintain number-to-frequency and frequency-to-number-count maps, updating both on each change.

edge_cases: Deleting a missing number has no effect.
A number leaving a frequency bucket decrements that bucket's distinct-number count.
